messages.author: 9d13cfb3458768d7
messages.subject: gl.filter functions freezing
parts:
Hi there,

Sorry if this is a very simple fix but it has me stumped.

After recently updating R, I now can't perform basic filtering of the dataset using the gl.filter.callrate, gl.filter.reproducibility or gl.filter.rdepth functions. My R console just freezes at the point of removing loci. The functions gl.filter.secondaries and gl.filter.monomorphs seem to work fine though?

I've tried re-installing different versions of R and installing and updating dartR via gl.install.vanilla.dartR() and gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "beta"), and have attempted using my own genlight as well as the bandicoot.gl dataset with no change or improvement. 

Any suggestions for a way forward would be much appreciated.

Many thanks!
Tom

p.s. I'm using macOS Monterey version 12.2.1, 
the latest version of R (4.2.2),
& R studio version 2022.12.0+353
